description.value:
As a Magic action while entirely within Dim Light or Darkness, you can expend 3 Ki Points to shroud yourself with shadows for 1 minute, until you have the Incapacitated condition, or until you end your turn in Bright Light. While shrouded by these shadows, you gain the following benefits.

  • Invisibility. You have the Invisible condition.
  • Partially Incorporeal. You can move through occupied spaces as if they were 3. If you end your turn in such a space, you are shunted to the last unoccupied space you were in.
  • Shadow Flurry. You can use your Flurry of Blows without expending any Ki Points. When you use your Improved Shadow Step, you can use Flurry of Blows as part of the same Bonus Action.
